wind_fan.name: Wind Fan
wind_fan.description: A steady fan that pushes the pod sideways through its column of wind.

balloon_cluster.name: Balloon Cluster
balloon_cluster.description: A bundle of balloons that bounces the pod upward. Pops after a few hits.

crystal_prism.name: Crystal Prism
crystal_prism.description: Refracts the pod as it passes, multiplying the value of what it catches afterward.

lightning_jar.name: Lightning Jar
lightning_jar.description: Zaps nearby pegs for bonus scrap when the pod drifts through its field.

chime_bell.name: Chime Bell
chime_bell.description: Rings as the pod passes, doubling the next barge catch. Limited uses per run.

magnet_buoy.name: Magnet Buoy
magnet_buoy.description: Gently pulls the pod toward itself from across the board.

cargo_net.name: Cargo Net
cargo_net.description: Catches the pod, holds it a beat, then flings it back into play. Single use.

splitter_vane.name: Splitter Vane
splitter_vane.description: Splits the pod in two, each half carrying part of the value.

gyro_damper.name: Gyro Damper
gyro_damper.description: Projects a calming field that deadens wild bounces.

piston_kicker.name: Piston Kicker
piston_kicker.description: Slams the pod sideways with a powerful mechanical kick.

sleet_sail.name: Sleet Sail
sleet_sail.description: An icy sail whose column slows the pod's fall to a drift.

gale_vent.name: Gale Vent
gale_vent.description: Erupts with a burst of storm air that launches the pod away.
